title: Sum of Array
prompt: Write a function sum(arr) that returns the sum of all numbers in the array.

title: Palindrome Check
prompt: Write isPalindrome(str) that returns true if the string reads the same forwards and backwards (ignore case).
hint: Normalize to lower case, then compare with the reversed string

title: FizzBuzz
prompt: Print numbers 1 to 30. For multiples of 3 print Fizz, of 5 print Buzz, of both print FizzBuzz.

title: Find Maximum
prompt: Write a function max_of_three(a, b, c) that returns the largest of three numbers without using max().

title: Reverse a String
prompt: Write reverse(str) that returns the string reversed.

title: Count Vowels
prompt: Write countVowels(str) that returns how many vowels (a,e,i,o,u) are in the string (case-insensitive).
hint: Loop through characters and check against 'aeiou'
